info.title: GraySpace Terrain API
info.description:
What the simulated internet offers and how it is doing, and the slices built at its edge: the
deployed base version, its inventory (routers, links, clients and core services with their addresses and status)
and DNS (every zone and record), shipped versions and their snapshots, capabilities, attachment points, slices,
instances and their manifests, jobs, images and roles, the CA bundle and the map layer. The base itself is deployed,
configured and destroyed through the API too.

Every route needs the deployment's bearer token (`GRAYSPACE_API_TOKEN`), sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
Live updates come over the `/api/v1/events` websocket (`grayspace-events-v1.json`).

**From nothing deployed to a base and a slice:**

1. `GET /api/v1/base/preflight?version=grayspace/2026.10&scope=tier1`: is the site ready? Fix every `error`.
2. `POST /api/v1/base/deploy` with `{"version": "grayspace/2026.10", "scope": "tier1"}`: returns a job.
3. `GET /api/v1/jobs/{id}` (or its streamed `/log`, or `/events`) until it succeeds; then `GET /api/v1/base` is `healthy`.
4. `PUT /api/v1/slices/{slug}` with a slice spec (`grayspace-slice-v1.json`); fix any error findings.
5. `POST /api/v1/instances` with `{"slice": "<slug>"}`: returns a job; when it succeeds, `GET /api/v1/instances/{id}` is the manifest.

Tear down in reverse: `DELETE /api/v1/instances/{id}`, then `DELETE /api/v1/base`. Long-running work is always a
job: poll it, read its log, cancel it, or retry it from the stage that failed.

get.description:
The deployed base version and its health.

The version comes from the `base` block that `task parse` writes into terraform.tfvars.json.
Health compares the routers in the tfvars with what Proxmox reports as running, and counts
BGP sessions up across all routers from Prometheus.

delete.description:
Destroy the base (task destroy). Refused while slice instances are live, unless
destroy_instances is true: then each live instance's destroy job is queued first, and the
base's destroy job last, which refuses to run if any instance is still live. Returns the jobs
in the order they run; the last is the base's.

parameters.name: destroy_instances

schema.description: Destroy every live slice instance first
schema.title: Destroy Instances

parameters.description: Destroy every live slice instance first

schema.title: Response Destroy Base Api V1 Base Delete

409.description: Live instances exist (pass destroy_instances=true), or another job is active

get.description:
What the deployed base consists of: ISPs; routers with their interfaces and addresses; links
with both ends' addresses and their state; clients (the hosts the base places on customer
networks) and core services (DNS servers and CAs) with their addresses. Read from the deployed
tfvars, so only what the deployment scope built. Status is Proxmox's, link state comes from
Prometheus. Slice instances are not included: GET /instances/{id} returns each one's manifest.

Every zone the simulated DNS serves and its records (all but the SOA), with the resolvers.
Each zone and record has an origin: base (the root and TLD zones task configure writes),
overlay (domains and records created in the web UI or by a scenario) or instance (created by a
slice instance, named in `instance`). Delegations sit in their TLD zone with the origin of the
domain they delegate.

Shipped base versions under bases/, with a summary of each and which one is deployed.

A version whose CSVs fail to load is listed with its problems instead of a summary.

schema.title: Response List Base Versions Api V1 Base Versions Get

get.description:
A base version and its topology snapshot: ISPs, locations, routers (with ISP and location)
and links. Version names contain a slash, e.g. /api/v1/base/versions/grayspace/2026.10.

Whether this site can deploy the base version at the scope: the settings, the Proxmox API and
node, storages (and their content types), bridges, SDN, SSH to the Proxmox host, capacity, and
live instances that a version change would break. A deploy is refused while any check is an
error, and runs these again as its first stage.

parameters.name: scope

schema.description: full or tier1; the deployed scope, else full
schema.title: Scope

parameters.description: full or tier1; the deployed scope, else full

post.description:
Deploy or update the base: preflight, parse, the guards, Terraform until converged, Ansible,
then a health check that waits for routers and BGP. Returns a job; poll GET /jobs/{id} or follow
/events, then GET /base. Deploying the deployed version again changes nothing. Without a
version, the deployed one is redeployed; with nothing deployed, a version is required.

409.description: Another base job is queued or running, or live instances would break

422.description: Preflight failed; detail.checks lists the errors

post.description: Run Ansible on the deployed base again (task configure), then the health check. Returns a job.

409.description: Nothing is deployed, or another base job is queued or running

What a slice can use on a base version: the image catalog and roles, the slice features this
GraySpace builds, whether it can run jobs, the management subnet and slice pool, DNS (TLDs,
hosting servers, resolvers), CAs, ISPs and their locations, and the Proxmox node's capacity
(CPU, memory and the block storage).

schema.title: Response List Slices Api V1 Slices Get

put.description:
Store a spec. A new version is stored whenever the content changes; storing the same content
again returns the same version (content hash). Returns the findings against the deployed
base: a spec with errors is stored, but can't be instantiated until they are resolved.

delete.description: Delete a slice and all its versions. Refused while an instance of it exists.

post.description: Findings for a spec against the deployed base, live instances and the node's capacity. Nothing is stored.

A plan job: the allocation preview, `terraform plan` in a scratch workspace, and the capacity
the instance would need. The job's `result` holds them when it finishes.

schema.title: Response List Instances Api V1 Instances Get

post.description:
Create an instance of a stored slice version (the latest unless one is pinned). The instance ID
is the slice's prefix, or `prefix` to run a second copy. Returns the instance ID and its
create job; poll GET /jobs/{id}, then GET /instances/{id} for the manifest.

422.description: The spec has errors against the deployed base; detail.findings lists them

get.description: The instance's state and manifest: sites, hosts (with management addresses and Proxmox status), DNS records and certificates.

delete.description:
A destroy job: revoke certificates, delete DNS records and domains, undo link conditions and BGP
attachments, terraform destroy, delete the workspace, free the allocations. Allowed from any
state, including a failed create; a create still queued or running is cancelled first.

post.description:
A runtime action on a ready instance (Phase C): link.condition, link.clear, link.down, link.up
on base links; dns.record.set and dns.record.delete within the instance's domains; host.start and
host.stop. Owned by the instance: quick reset leaves them, destroy undoes them.

409.description: The instance isn't ready, or another owner holds the link (LINK_OWNED)

post.description: Cancel at the next stage boundary. A create that is cancelled leaves the instance failed, to be retried or destroyed.
Run a failed or cancelled job again. Creates and base jobs resume at the stage that failed; destroys and plans start over, which is safe because every stage is idempotent.

get.description:
The map as GeoJSON (RFC 7946) with current state: routers (positions already fanned out per
city), links (great-circle LineStrings, split at the 180° meridian), and slice sites, internet
hosts and their attachments. Colors and states are properties, so every map draws the same
thing; updates arrive by feature id over /api/v1/events (feature.update) and /ws.
The root certificates of every deployed base CA, for hosts outside GraySpace (such as GHOSTS) that must trust them.
